rules.title: Catenation (Consonant-to-Vowel Linking)
rules.description: When a word ends in a consonant and the next begins with a vowel sound, the consonant moves across the boundary.

rules.title: Elision (Sound Deletion)
rules.example: Next door -> [neks dɔːr], Diamond ring -> [ˈdaɪ.mən rɪŋ]
rules.description: In fast speech, weak vowels and alveolar stops (/t/ and /d/) disappear between consonants.

rules.title: Assimilation (Sound Transformation)
rules.example: white paper -> whipe paper, don't you -> [dəʊntʃuː]
rules.description: Alveolar consonants (/t/, /d/, /n/) adopt the place of articulation of the following consonant.

rules.title: Weak Forms & The Schwa (/ə/)
rules.description: Stress-timed rhythm collapses grammatical function words to weak unstressed schwa syllables.

accents.name: General American (GA)
accents.markers: Rhotic /r/, flap [ɾ] for t/d, broad æ in bath.

accents.name: Received Pronunciation (RP)
accents.markers: Non-rhotic, long open ɑː, glottal stop [ʔ].

protocol.name: Gist Capture
protocol.focus: Macro meaning, 1.0x playback, no pauses. Write 3 bullet summary.

protocol.name: Micro-Verbatim Transcription
protocol.focus: Loop 5-8 second chunks, 0.8x-1.0x. Type verbatim text.

protocol.name: Phonetic Gap Analysis
protocol.focus: Compare against transcript, mark red highlights for elision/linking.

samplePassages.title: Algorithmic Optimization & Cognitive Load
samplePassages.audioText: In an era dominated by algorithmic feed optimization, the human cognitive bandwidth has become the ultimate scarce commodity.
samplePassages.ipa: /ɪn ən ˈɪərə ˈdɒmɪneɪtɪd baɪ ˌælɡəˈrɪðmɪk fiːd ˌɒptɪmaɪˈzeɪʃən ðə ˈhjuːmən ˈkɒɡnɪtɪv ˈbændwɪdθ hæz bɪˈkʌm ði ˈʌltɪmət skeəs kəˈmɒdəti/
samplePassages.traps: Note elision in "feed optimization" and catenation in "In an era" [ɪ-nə-nɪərə].

samplePassages.title: Organizational Agility in Distributed Teams
samplePassages.audioText: Organizations that prioritize synchronous consensus often suffer from severe decision paralysis and diminished velocity.
samplePassages.ipa: /ˌɔːɡənaɪˈzeɪʃənz ðæt praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz ˈsɪŋkrənəs kənˈsɛnsəs ˈɒf(ə)n ˈsʌfər frəm sɪˈvɪər dɪˈsɪʒən pəˈræləsɪs ənd dɪˈmɪnɪʃt vɪˈlɒsɪti/
samplePassages.traps: Weak form "frəm" and assimilation in "often suffer".

samplePassages.title: The Paradox of Creative Constraints
samplePassages.audioText: Without arbitrary limitations to direct their focus, most creators fall prey to the paralysis of infinite choice.
samplePassages.ipa: /wɪˈðaʊt ˈɑːbɪtrəri ˌlɪmɪˈteɪʃənz tuː daɪˈrɛkt ðeə ˈfəʊkəs məʊst kriˈeɪtəz fɔːl preɪ tuː ðə pəˈræləsɪs ɒv ˈɪnfɪnɪt tʃɔɪs/
samplePassages.traps: Elision of final /t/ in "most creators" -> [məʊs kriˈeɪtəz].

samplePassages.title: Compound Interest as Behavior
samplePassages.audioText: What looks like patience is usually just a system that keeps working while you are not looking at it.
samplePassages.ipa: /wɒt lʊks laɪk ˈpeɪʃəns ɪz ˈjuːʒuəli dʒʌst ə ˈsɪstəm ðət kiːps ˈwɜːkɪŋ waɪl juː ɑː nɒt ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ɪt/
samplePassages.traps: Weak /ðət/ for "that"; linking in "looking at it" [lʊ-kɪ-ŋæ-tɪt].

samplePassages.title: Why Meetings Multiply
samplePassages.audioText: Every unresolved question quietly schedules another meeting, and nobody notices until the calendar is full.
samplePassages.ipa: /ˈevri ˌʌnrɪˈzɒlvd ˈkwestʃən ˈkwaɪətli ˈʃedjuːlz əˈnʌðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ənd ˈnəʊbədi ˈnəʊtɪsɪz ʌnˈtɪl ðə ˈkælɪndə ɪz fʊl/
samplePassages.traps: Elision of /d/ in "unresolved question"; schwa in "another".

samplePassages.title: The Cost of Context Switching
samplePassages.audioText: Each interruption costs far more than the seconds it takes, because the mind has to rebuild the whole picture.
samplePassages.ipa: /iːtʃ ˌɪntəˈrʌpʃən kɒsts fɑː mɔː ðən ðə ˈsekəndz ɪt teɪks bɪˈkɒz ðə maɪnd hæz tə riːˈbɪld ðə həʊl ˈpɪktʃə/
samplePassages.traps: Weak "to" /tə/ in "has to rebuild"; "costs far" drops the /t/ [kɒs fɑː].

samplePassages.title: Trust and Transparency
samplePassages.audioText: People forgive a mistake they can see, but they rarely forgive one that was hidden from them.
samplePassages.ipa: /ˈpiːpl fəˈgɪv ə mɪˈsteɪk ðeɪ kæn siː bʌt ðeɪ ˈreəli fəˈgɪv wʌn ðət wəz ˈhɪdn frɒm ðem/
samplePassages.traps: Elision of /k/ in "mistake they"; weak forms /wəz/, /frɒm/.

samplePassages.title: Learning by Teaching
samplePassages.audioText: If you cannot explain an idea in plain words, you probably do not understand it as well as you think.
samplePassages.ipa: /ɪf juː ˈkænɒt ɪkˈspleɪn ən aɪˈdɪə ɪn pleɪn wɜːdz juː ˈprɒbəbli duː nɒt ˌʌndəˈstænd ɪt əz wel əz juː θɪŋk/
samplePassages.traps: Catenation in "explain an idea" [ɪk-spleɪ-nə-naɪ-dɪə]; "do not" often reduces to "don't".

samplePassages.title: The Slow Skill of Listening
samplePassages.audioText: Good listeners wait for the speaker to finish before they decide what they think about what was said.
samplePassages.ipa: /gʊd ˈlɪsnəz weɪt fə ðə ˈspiːkə tə ˈfɪnɪʃ bɪˈfɔː ðeɪ dɪˈsaɪd wɒt ðeɪ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt wɒt wəz sed/
samplePassages.traps: Weak /fə/ and /tə/; elision of /t/ in "wait for" and "what they".
